notes: First spawn round (2026-07-27) wedged: codex+HSR does not accept a positional prompt at spawn; all five bees booted to nothing and were auto-retired. Respawned bare and briefed via hive send. W2 spawns follow the same rule: spawn BARE, wait idle, brief via hive send, canary one before the rest. W3 addendum: original wax-w3c (CO.a5b) wedged mid-turn three times at the long-fuzz-rerun step and stopped responding to sends; retired 2026-07-28 with its nearly-finished work coordinator-checkpointed as wip commit d1757f4 on agent/wax-w3c-safety; replacement wax-w3c2 spawned into the same worktree to finish (short smokes, checks, seal). W3C required coordinator takeover: two successive codex bees (CO.a5b, CO.9821) wedged mid-turn at the fuzz step; CO.a5b's work was checkpointed as d1757f4 and the coordinator finished, corpus-fitted (126 false rejections removed), and merged the shard. W4 addendum: HIVE-81 (honeybee bug, operator-filed) wedged EVERY detached codex spawn at the app-server handshake on 2026-07-28 midday - 2 canaries + 16 staggered retries all died with zero output; root cause was the spawn executing in a detached bee shell. Working path per CL.161: run hive spawn from the coordinator's apiary shelf terminal (user-session context) via terminal_spawn/terminal_write; all four W4 bees then booted in seconds (canary wax-w4a8 first). Codex trust-dialog on first boot per home answered via tmux send-keys Enter. Shelf terminal surface is ephemeral - one immediate command per write, re-list ptyId each time, no sleep-chains. W5 addendum (2026-07-28 eve): coordinator shelf terminal died after two spawns (terminal_spawn ok / terminal_list [] / self terminals:[]) and agentSurface.terminal.new + shelf.toggle via command_run are gateway-approval-gated. Pre-trusting the worktree in every codex home config.toml ([projects."<abs>"] trust_level="trusted") did NOT unwedge a detached spawn - wax-w5d went booting->wedged anyway, so the trust dialog is NOT the full HIVE-81 mechanism; user-session execution context matters beyond trust. Only proven path remains a working session's shelf terminal - w5d was spawned from parent CL.161's shelf on request. Also: codex shards end their turn after the ack buz; the go/approval must arrive via hive send (immediate), never buz queue (30-60 min lag), or they sit 'done' doing nothing.
